title: Velvety Vietnamese Chestnut Canh Chua Bamboo Tray
description: A comforting, cultured Vietnamese dish featuring cooked chestnuts in a rich and velvety broth, perfect for a weekend brunch on a bamboo tray.

ingredients.name: sliced bamboo shoots
ingredients.notes: fresh or canned, drained and sliced

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of lemongrass oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add sliced ginger and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add chicken broth, kosher salt, roasted chestnuts, and kombu seaweed. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes.
Remove kombu seaweed and add sliced bamboo shoots, fish sauce, black peppercorns, and cayenne pepper. Simmer for an additional 10 minutes, until the broth is rich and velvety.
Stir in coconut milk and bamboo shoots liquid. Cook for 2-3 minutes, until heated through.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Transfer the Canh Chua to a bamboo tray and garnish with fresh lemongrass and lime wedges.
